title: Ornate Bear Sword
description: A highly detailed fantasy sword lies diagonally on a dark, textured background. The weapon features a large, jagged metallic blade with red and gold accents, while the hilt is wrapped in red leather and adorned with a roaring bear head, black fur, large horns, and a clawed pommel.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy sword with a massive jagged blade showing red and gold inlays lies diagonally against a dark textured background. The hilt is wrapped in red leather with intricate bindings, featuring a roaring bear head with horns, black fur trim, large ivory horns, and a clawed metal pommel with a hanging feather.
